title: IFC spaces rendered as solid colour — should be hidden or 10% opacity
description: IfcSpace volumes appear as solid coloured masses in the viewer overlay. They should either be fully hidden or rendered at ~10% opacity so they don't obscure the building geometry.

title: Vertical edge drag should snap to other vertical edges, not just face planes
description: When dragging a vertical (corner) edge, snapping only considers planes of faces. It should also detect and prioritise alignment with other vertical edges in the scene.

title: Cell drag: prioritise snapping when a cell edge aligns with scene edges
description: Dragging a cell snaps to planes nicely, but when one of the cell's edges aligns with edges already in the scene those shared-edge positions should be prioritised over generic plane snaps.

title: Face drag should snap to all scene edges that intersect the drag plane
description: When dragging a face, snapping currently only considers the dragged cell's own geometry. It should check all edges in the scene for intersection with the drag plane and snap to those too.

title: Cell can be dragged outside the view grid and becomes unretrievable
description: There is no boundary check on drag. A cell dragged past the edge of the visible grid disappears and cannot be selected or recovered without a reset.

title: Clicking cell doesn't select it — only dragging works, which moves the cell
description: Clicking the generated model or a cell in the editor should expose the properties panel/controls without moving anything. Currently the only way to select is to drag, but that immediately starts a move.
